Provide what you can confirm; write "unknown" rather than guessing.

### Game and environment

- Game, version, platform/launcher:
- Aurora version (prefer the overlay/log version) and download source:
- Exact GPU, driver and OS versions:
- Proxy, e.g. dxgi.dll / winmm.dll:
- Other mods, bridges and loaders with versions:

### Upscaling and frame generation

- Game upscaler and native FG setting:
- Aurora FG Input / FG Output / FG Nvngx Replacement:
- Fixed multiplier or Dynamic MFG; saved settings and full restart:
- Loaded DLSSG / Streamline versions, if known:

### Symptoms and reproduction

Does it happen on startup, loading, scene changes, multiplier/FG toggles or exit? Always or intermittently? Last working Aurora/game version?

1.
2.
3.

Include the full error code. For disappearing files, identify the filename and corresponding launcher/security-software records without assuming the cause.

### Attachments

- Prefer OptiScaler.log from the failing run, compressed if large; avoid mixing runs.
- Relevant overlay/error screenshots; provide crash dumps only if subsequently requested.
- Review personal paths, account details and other private information before uploading.

Missing overlay, slow menus, component errors and GPU crashes are different symptoms. See the [guide](https://github.com/abc354402600/OptiScaler-Aurora/blob/aurora/docs/GUIDE.en.md) and [known limitations](https://github.com/abc354402600/OptiScaler-Aurora/blob/aurora/docs/COMPATIBILITY.en.md).
